description: PROD seam leak: the harness reads FOUNDER_LEDGER UNCONDITIONALLY (no FOUNDER_TEST gate) and uses it as the goal-check ledger, but record-earn.mjs treats FOUNDER_LEDGER as a TEST-ONLY seam (record-earn.mjs:24 = `(TEST && process.env.FOUNDER_LEDGER) || .../earn-ledger.jsonl`) so in prod the recorder ALWAYS writes $DIR/state/earn-ledger.jsonl and ignores FOUNDER_LEDGER. Consequence: in PROD (FOUNDER_TEST unset) anyone/anything that can set FOUNDER_LEDGER in the harness's environment (a cron/launchd env line, an inherited/exported shell var, a compromised wrapper) points the goal-check at an attacker-controlled file. A file containing `{"earn_usdc":999}` makes the harness write `realised_earn_usdc: 999` and `status: EARNING` into the durable STATE.md while the REAL recorder ledger holds $0 — a fabricated/inflated earning that bypasses every record-earn anti-fake gate (INV-1..7) and mislead the goal-check, with NO FOUNDER_TEST required. This is exactly the threat the recorder closed via FIND-401 (prod must be env-independent; test-record-earn.sh:18 enumerates FOUNDER_LEDGER as a seam that MUST be TEST-gated). The harness re-opens it. Violates INV-H2 (goal must reflect what record-earn wrote) and INV-H5 (realised_earn must be backed by the REAL ledger).
fix: Gate FOUNDER_LEDGER behind FOUNDER_TEST exactly as the recorder does, AND/OR derive the ledger path the SAME way record-earn resolves it (never an independent env): e.g. `if [ "${FOUNDER_TEST:-}" = "1" ] && [ -n "${FOUNDER_LEDGER:-}" ]; then LEDGER="$FOUNDER_LEDGER"; else LEDGER="$DIR/state/earn-ledger.jsonl"; fi`. In prod the goal-check MUST read the identical file record-earn wrote — $DIR/state/earn-ledger.jsonl — independent of the ambient environment.
